component.name: OccluView
component.summary: Advanced Mesh Repair and Mesh Editing for dental CAD

description.p: OccluView is an advanced dental CAD workspace for Mesh Repair and Mesh Editing. It opens dental scans and common mesh files in a native desktop viewport with orthographic orbit and pan, a cut view, a surface ruler, and a thickness analyser.

Scans load as layers with their own visibility, opacity, tint, and wireframe. Selections are made by click, rectangle, or lasso, and Mesh Editing can delete, crop, cut, separate, close holes, and smooth, with undo and redo throughout. Mesh Repair removes damaged topology and reports its changes. Two scans can be aligned against each other and compared through a discrepancy heatmap. Edited layers export back to STL, PLY, or OBJ.

STL, PLY, OBJ, GLB, and HPS dental containers are supported. The package registers the file types with the desktop and installs a thumbnailer, so scans get real previews in the file manager, along with occluview-cli for headless thumbnails and conversion.
